items.action: Write the MM2 dedicated-mode config at workspace/mm2/mm2.properties. clusters=redpanda,kafka; redpanda.bootstrap.servers=redpanda:29092; kafka.bootstrap.servers=kafka:29092; replication.policy.class=org.apache.kafka.connect.mirror.IdentityReplicationPolicy (names stay the same, so no consumer config changes); redpanda->kafka.enabled=true with redpanda->kafka.topics=tenant\.tenant\.events; kafka->redpanda.enabled=true with kafka->redpanda.topics=catalog\.product\.events|catalog\.category\.events|catalog\.attribute\.events. Disable everything else: groups=, emit.checkpoints.enabled=false, sync.group.offsets.enabled=false, emit.heartbeats.enabled=false, sync.topic.configs.enabled=false, sync.topic.acls.enabled=false. Set redpanda.consumer.auto.offset.reset=earliest and kafka.consumer.auto.offset.reset=earliest, and set every replication factor (replication.factor, offset-syncs/checkpoints/heartbeats.topic.replication.factor, config/offset/status.storage.replication.factor) to 1.

Record the Redpanda end offsets of all four topics (E1). Gate G2: if image-service does not reach lag 0, stop and scale catalog-service back to 1.
